findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe YAML loading
 * @description Using yaml.load or yaml.load_all with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-yaml-loading
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "load_all"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe YAML loading operation that could execute arbitrary code. Use yaml.safe_load() instead."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe YAML loading using yaml.load() or yaml.load_all() could allow arbitrary code execution via YAML tags

message.text: Potentially unsafe YAML loading operation that could execute arbitrary code. Use yaml.safe_load() instead.
